import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        long val;
        static final long MOD = 1000000007;

        public Modular() {
            this.val = 0;
        }

        public <U> Modular(U v) {
            long value = ((Number) v).longValue() % MOD;
            if (value < 0) value += MOD;
            this.val = value;
        }

        public static Modular get(long v) {
            return new Modular(v);
        }

        public static Modular one() {
            return new Modular(1);
        }

        public static Modular zero() {
            return new Modular(0);
        }

        public static Modular fromPercentage(int percentage) {
            return new Modular(percentage).multiply(new Modular(1).divide(new Modular(100)));
        }

        public Modular add(Modular m) {
            this.val += m.val;
            if (this.val >= MOD) this.val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular subtract(Modular m) {
            this.val -= m.val;
            if (this.val < 0) this.val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular multiply(Modular m) {
            this.val = (this.val * m.val) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular pow(long p) {
            Modular result = Modular.one();
            Modular base = new Modular(this.val);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public Modular inv() {
            // Fermat's little theorem for modular inverse
            return this.pow(MOD - 2);
        }

        public Modular divide(Modular m) {
            return this.multiply(m.inv());
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int number = sc.nextInt();
        int size = number * number;
        Modular[] probability = new Modular[size];

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int percentage = sc.nextInt();
            probability[i] = Modular.fromPercentage(percentage);
        }

        List<Modular> total = new ArrayList<>();
        int middle = number / 2;

        int[] maskValue = new int[1 << 6];
        assert number <= 6;
        int count = 0;
        for (int matchMask = 0; matchMask < (1 << 6); matchMask++) {
            maskValue[matchMask] = Integer.bitCount(matchMask) == middle ? count++ : -1;
        }
        total = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(1 << count, Modular.zero()));

        // process function
        process(probability, total, number, middle, maskValue, (sets, probabilityVal) -> {
            total.set(sets, total.get(sets).add(probabilityVal));
        });

        // subset sum
        for (int dim = 1; dim < total.size(); dim <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < total.size(); i++) {
                if ((i & dim) == 0) {
                    total.set(i | dim, total.get(i | dim).add(total.get(i)));
                }
            }
        }

        Modular result = Modular.zero();

        process(probability, total, number, middle, maskValue, (sets, probabilityVal) -> {
            result = result.add(probabilityVal.multiply(new Modular(1).subtract(total.get(total.size() - 1 - sets))));
        });

        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }

    interface Handle {
        void apply(int sets, Modular probability);
    }

    static void process(Modular[] probability, List<Modular> total, int number, int middle, int[] maskValue, Handle handle) {
        int len = 0; // placeholder, actual length is handled in the calling context
        int totalMaskSize = 1 << (len * number);
        for (int edgeMask = 0; edgeMask < totalMaskSize; edgeMask++) {
            Modular totalProbability = Modular.one();

            // simulate the inner loop
            int tmp = edgeMask;
            for (int i = 0; i < len * number; i++, tmp >>= 1) {
                if ((tmp & 1) != 0) {
                    totalProbability = totalProbability.multiply(probability[i]);
                } else {
                    totalProbability = totalProbability.multiply(new Modular(1).subtract(probability[i]));
                }
                if (totalProbability.val == 0) break;
            }
            if (totalProbability.val == 0) continue;

            // compute matchSets
            int matchSets = 0;
            int[] data = new int[6]; // max size
            Arrays.fill(data, 0);
            int currentLen = len;
            while (true) {
                int matchMask = 0;
                boolean continueOuter = false;
                for (int index = 0; index < currentLen; index++) {
                    if (((edgeMask >> (index * number + data[index])) & 1) == 0) {
                        continueOuter = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    if (((matchMask >> data[index]) & 1) != 0) {
                        continueOuter = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    matchMask |= 1 << data[index];
                }
                if (continueOuter) {
                    // increase data
                    int i = currentLen - 1;
                    while (i >= 0) {
                        if (data[i] == number - 1) {
                            data[i] = 0;
                            i--;
                        } else {
                            data[i]++;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (i < 0) break;
                    continue;
                }
                if (number == 0) {
                    matchMask ^= (1 << number) - 1;
                }
                matchSets |= 1 << maskValue[matchMask];

                // increase data
                int i = currentLen - 1;
                while (i >= 0) {
                    if (data[i] == number - 1) {
                        data[i] = 0;
                        i--;
                    } else {
                        data[i]++;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (i < 0) break;
            }

            handle.apply(matchSets, totalProbability);
        }
    }
}
